clips.send: In many questions, the question word comes first and the verb comes before the subject. You can leave out the subject when it’s clear. When the question word asks who is doing the action, that word is itself the subject.

clips.send: Common mistake: Ask why with por qué, two words with an accent. Give a reason with porque, one word without an accent.
clips.text: Common mistake: Ask why with por qué, two words with an accent. Give a reason with porque, one word without an accent.

clips.send: Memory tip: Put an opening and a closing question mark around a direct question. Mark the stressed vowel in each question word. When cuánto and its other forms describe a noun, match its gender and number.

clips.send: 记忆小窍门：直接问句前后都要写问号，疑问词的重读元音要写重音符号。cuánto 等形式修饰名词时，要和名词的性、数一致。
